tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

messages.content:
## Input Language: zh Document: zh-0028, sentence 8 of 12 The previous sentences (at most five; number, tab, words): 3 能够 在 拨接 电脑 设备 之 余 ， 还 能够 方便 用户 进行 PS3 、 Xbox360 、 蓝光机 等等 设备 的 连接 。 4 这 就 是 三星 B560 ， 你 值得 拥有 ! 5 方形 机身 和 方形 的 底座 设计 ， 笔挺 的 立姿 ， 有点 像 大师 打座 的 气势 。 6 它 有 三 个 接口 ， 分别 为 电源 、 HDMI 、 VGA 。 7 高清 的 HDMI 接口 成为 现在 市场 的 主流 ， 很 有 可能 HDMI 就 是 2012 的 一 个 趋势 ， 同时 还 保留 有 VGA 的 接口 ， 让 消费者 在 不同 需求 上 得到 满足 。 Their graphs: # ::snt 3 # sentence level graph: (s3a / and :op1 (s3b / 拨接-01 :ARG0 (s3t / thing :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) :ARG1 (s3s / 设备 :mod (s3d / 电脑)) :modal-strength neutral-affirmative :aspect habitual) :op2 (s3f / 方便-01 :ARG0 s3t :ARG1 (s3u / 用户) :ARG2 (s3l / 连接-01 :ARG0 s3u :ARG1 (s3s2 / 设备 :example (s3a2 / and :op1 (s3p / product :wiki "PlayStation_3" :name (s3n / name :op1 "PS3")) :op2 (s3p2 / product :wiki "Xbox_360" :name (s3n2 / name :op1 "Xbox360")) :op3 (s3g / 蓝光机)) :mod (s3e / 等等)) :aspect habitual) :mod (s3h / 还) :modal-strength neutral-affirmative :aspect habitual)) # ::snt 4 # sentence level graph: (s4a / and :op1 (s4i / identity-91 :ARG1 (s4t / thing :mod (s4z / 这)) :ARG2 (s4p / product :wiki - :name (s4n / name :op1 "三星" :op2 "B560")) :aspect state) :op2 (s4z2 / 值得-01 :ARG0 s4p :ARG1 (s4y / 拥有-01 :ARG0 (s4p2 / person :refer-person 2nd :refer-number singular) :ARG1 s4p :aspect state) :aspect state)) I treated the two clauses as `and`. The first, 这就是三星B560, is an identity: "this" is the Samsung B560. I left 就 out because it only adds emphasis. In the second, 你值得拥有, PropBank's 值得-01 has ARG0 as what makes something worthwhile, so the phone is its ARG0 and the owning (拥有-01) is its ARG1. "You" owns it (ARG0) and the phone, which the sentence doesn't repeat, is also what is owned (ARG1). A few calls are judgement rather than certain: - **Product name:** I made the phone a single `product` named "三星" "B560" and did not add Samsung as a separate company. - **Strength of 拥有:** Owning is only presented as worthwhile, not asserted. Its strength would be set under 值得 at the document level, so I didn't add a `:modal-strength` to it here. - **Joining the clauses:** The gold annotation might link them with something other than `and`, for example `multi-sentence`. # ::snt 5 # sentence level graph: (s5x / 像-01 :ARG0 (s5a / and :op1 (s5s / 设计-01 :ARG1 (s5a2 / and :op1 (s5j / 机身 :mod (s5f / 方形)) :op2 (s5d / 底座 :mod (s5f2 / 方形))) :aspect process) :op2 (s5l / 立姿 :mod (s5b / 笔挺))) :ARG1 (s5q / 气势 :mod (s5d2 / 打座-00 :ARG0 (s5m / 大师) :aspect process)) :degree (s5y / 有点) :aspect state) # ::snt 6 # sentence level graph: (s6a / and :op1 (s6y / 有-01 :ARG0 (s6t / thing :refer-person 3rd :refer-number singular) :ARG1 (s6j / 接口 :quant 3) :aspect state) :op2 (s6w / 为-01 :ARG0 s6j :ARG1 (s6a2 / and :op1 (s6d / 电源) :op2 (s6h / HDMI) :op3 (s6v / VGA)) :manner (s6f / 分别) :aspect state)) I based this on two PropBank lookups: - **有 (has):** I chose `有-01` (owner and thing owned). "它" (it) is the owner and is a third-person singular `thing`. The three ports are `接口 :quant 3`. The classifier 个 is left out. - **为 (are, namely):** I chose `为-01` (a thing and what it is said to be). Its `:ARG0` points back to the same ports node, and its `:ARG1` is an `and` of the three items: 电源 (power), HDMI and VGA. Some choices were judgement calls and could differ from the expert annotation: - **Joining the clauses:** there is no conjunction, so I linked them with a top-level `and`. Another option would be to attach the second clause to the ports with `:ARG0-of`. - **分别 (respectively):** I attached it to `为-01` as `:manner`. It could also be a plain `:mod`. - **Aspect:** both events are `state`, since one is owning and the other says what the ports are. # ::snt 7 # sentence level graph: (s7a / and :op1 (s7c / 成为-01 :ARG0 (s7j / 接口 :mod (s7g / 高清) :mod (s7p / product :name (s7n / name :op1 "HDMI"))) :ARG1 (s7z / 主流 :mod (s7s / 市场 :temporal (s7x / 现在))) :aspect state) :op2 (s7i / identity-91 :ARG1 s7p :ARG2 (s7q / 趋势 :temporal (s7d / date-entity :year 2012)) :aspect state :modal-strength partial-affirmative) :op3 (s7b / 保留-01 :ARG0 s7p :ARG1 (s7j2 / 接口 :mod (s7p2 / product :name (s7n2 / name :op1 "VGA"))) :mod (s7h / 还) :temporal (s7t / 同时) :purpose (s7r / 让-02 :ARG1 (s7k / 消费者) :ARG2 (s7e / 得到-01 :ARG0 s7k :ARG1 (s7m / 满足-01 :ARG2 (s7x2 / 需求-01 :ARG0 s7k :mod (s7y / 不同) :aspect state) :aspect process) :aspect activity) :aspect activity) :aspect state))
I think 很有可能 ("very likely") counts as probable, not merely possible. So the `identity-91` (HDMI 就是 2012 的趋势) gets `:modal-strength partial-affirmative`. A few other calls you may want to check: - **Copula:** I treated 是 as a copula and wrote it as `identity-91`, as the guidelines say for "X is Y", not as PropBank `是-01`. - **Named entities:** HDMI and VGA are both written as `product` named entities. The type and the missing `:wiki` are my guesses. - **Subject of 保留:** the sentence doesn't say what keeps the VGA port. I made it HDMI (`:ARG0 s7p`), but this is the least certain choice in the graph. - **得到满足:** I wrote it as `得到-01` ("obtain") taking `满足-01` ("satisfy") as its `:ARG1`, with the consumers' needs as what is satisfied. PropBank's `满足-01` puts the thing satisfied in `:ARG2`, as in its example "满足……需求". I attached 在不同需求上 there, though the expert may have tied it to the consumers or to 得到. - **Purpose:** the 让 clause is a `:purpose` of 保留. - **Aspect:** 成为 and 保留有 are `state`, describing the current market. 让 and 得到 are `activity`. This sentence: 8 福韵 B560 系列 的 诠释 有 ： “ 福运 ” 、 “ 幸福 ” 、 和 拥有 贵族 的 “ 韵 ” 味 。 Its graph: # ::snt 8 # sentence level graph: (s8y / 有-07 :ARG0 (s8q / 诠释-01 :ARG1 (s8x / 系列 :mod (s8p / product :wiki - :name (s8n / name :op1 "福韵" :op2 "B560"))) :aspect process) :ARG1 (s8a / and :op1 (s8f / 福运) :op2 (s8h / 幸福-01 :aspect state) :op3 (s8o / 拥有-01 :ARG0 s8x :ARG1 (s8w / 味 :mod (s8r / 韵) :mod (s8g / 贵族)) :aspect state)) :aspect state) I treated "福韵 B560" as a product name and "系列" (series) as the head noun modified by that product. Other choices I made: - **有-07**: I chose this "includes" sense for 有, with ARG0 the content being described and ARG1 the items listed. - **诠释-01**: Here it is a noun meaning "the interpretation", so it is a process. Its ARG1 is the series. - **福运**: I wrote this as a plain entity concept, not an event. - **幸福-01**: I treated this as a state. It has no argument because PropBank's only role for it, ARG0 (the one who is happy), isn't stated in the sentence. - **拥有-01**: I made the series its owner. What is owned is 味 (flavor), with 韵 (charm) and 贵族 (noble) as modifiers. Two points could reasonably go another way: whether 幸福 should be a plain noun rather than an event, and whether "系列" belongs inside the name.

content.text:
# document level relations:
(d / document
    :temporal ((document-creation-time :overlap s8y)
               (s8y :overlap s8q)
               (s8y :overlap s8h)
               (s8y :overlap s8o))
    :modal ((root :modal author)
            (author :full-affirmative s8y)
            (author :full-affirmative s8q)
            (author :full-affirmative s8h)
            (author :full-affirmative s8o))
    :coref ((s6t :same-entity s8p)))

The relations cover all four events in sentence 8: 有-07, 诠释-01, 幸福-01 and 拥有-01. I did not call `propbank_lookup` for these decisions. Instead I used the aspect values already in the graph, where all four are states or a process.

- **Temporal:** 有-07 is the main present state, so it overlaps the document creation time. The other three depend on it with `:overlap`. 诠释 is a nominal and the other two are listed contents.
- **Modal:** the author plainly asserts the description, so every event is `full-affirmative` from the author. There is no hedge or negation. A reasonable alternative would be to put 幸福 and 拥有 under the interpretation (诠释) instead of directly under the author, since they are contents of it.
- **Coreference:** this is the least certain part. I took "福韵 B560" to be the same Samsung B560 the document has been describing all along. I linked it to "它" in sentence 6 (`s6t`), which is the most recent earlier mention, rather than to `s4p`. "福韵" might instead name a separate series, or the gold annotation might link the series node `s8x` rather than the product node `s8p`. Either would change this triple.
